open_points.subject: repair view contents
open_points.text: State 4 says the repair view contains “the slot's contract versions and implementations” and a page of NodeExecutions, while A15 rule 6 requires “its trial cases and executions” as well.
open_points.question: Must the repair view return the slot's trial cases and TrialExecutions in addition to its contracts, implementations and recent NodeExecutions?
options: Include trial cases and TrialExecutions as required by A15 rule 6
Return only the records listed in State 4
open_points.default_guess: Include trial cases and TrialExecutions as required by A15 rule 6.

open_points.subject: start-up recovery of operation waits
open_points.text: State 4 says recovery acts by “reaching again, through capability:effects.reach_operation_element, an operation element whose wait no longer holds”, while A11 says an unknown attempt resolved applied must count as succeeded or failed without another send.
open_points.question: Which cleared waits cause recovery to call reach_operation_element, and which instead only cause runs to derive the recorded conclusion and advance downstream nodes?
options: Reach again only after an approval decision or a not_applied resolution; derive applied resolutions without reaching the operation again
Reach every operation element whose waiting point has cleared
open_points.default_guess: Reach again only when a send is still required; for an applied resolution, derive the conclusion without reaching or sending the operation again.
